blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.
blocks.zh: 视频场景图生成(VidSGG)旨在捕捉视频中的物体及其演变中的关系. 这需要既考虑到物体特性的持久性,又考虑到关系突变。 现有方法汇总跨框架的信息,以利用时间背景,但强调一致性可以掩盖这些变化。 因此,即使在基本关系发生变化之后,一个模型也可能保留其先前的预测. 我们把这种失败模式称为关系语义惯性. 为解决这一问题,我们提议采用 " 关系转换器 " (RTAformer),这是一个将实体持续模式和关系变化分开的阶段框架。 它在相邻方格关系查询之间注入校准差异,以指导上游更新,而跨方格实例在培训期间的调整有助于减少跨方格代表漂移。 行动基因组实验显示,比起现有方法,在召回和平均召回方面有所改进,利用匹配的骨干来支持拟议组成部分的贡献和比较,显示在关系过渡框架方面比在非过渡框架方面收益更大。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) represents objects and their relationships in videos as structured ⟨ \langle subject, predicate, object ⟩ \rangle triplets, with entities as nodes and relationships as edges.
By explicitly representing who interacts with what and how these relationships evolve, video scene graphs provide structured information for action selection in embodied navigation and planning [ 9 , 34 , 24 ] and for interpreting events in video-language reasoning and question answering [ 21 , 3 , 27 ] .
Approaches to VidSGG have evolved from multi-stage pipelines for object detection, temporal association, and relation classification [ 4 , 14 , 6 ] to one-stage frameworks that integrate instance and relation prediction, reducing reliance on external tracking [ 9 , 10 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频场景图形生成(VidSGG)在视频中代表对象及其关系,作为结构化的\\\langle主题,上游,对象\\\rangle 三重体,以实体为节点和关系为边缘.
视频场景图明确代表了谁与这些关系发生互动以及如何演变,提供了结构化的信息,用于在体现的导航和规划中选择行动[9、34、24],并用于以视频语言推理和回答问题[21、3、27]解释事件。
VidSGG的方法已从用于物体探测、时间关联和关系分类的多阶段管道[4、14、6]发展为将实例和关系预测结合起来的一阶段框架,从而减少了对外部跟踪的依赖[9、10、5]。

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, capturing abrupt relation changes remains challenging when the same entities persist across frames.
While existing approaches aggregate information across frames to improve predictions [ 4 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 38 ] , explicitly modeling relation changes for persistent entity pairs has received comparatively less attention.
In such cases, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed.
Figure 1 (a) illustrates this behavior: the same subject–object pair remains visible, but its relation changes from looking at to not looking at , while a baseline model [ 9 ] continues to predict looking at .
Our reimplementation of the baseline [ 9 ] achieves an R@10 of 34.3 on the relation-transition frame subset, compared with 45.9 on the non-transition frame subset under the with constraint setting (Fig. 1 (b)).
We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia .
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但当同一实体持续跨框架时,反映突然的关系变化仍然具有挑战性。
虽然现有方法汇总了跨框架的信息,以改进预测[4、8、9、10、38],但明确对持久性实体对关系变化的建模得到了相对较少的关注。
在这种情况下,即使基本关系发生变化,一个模型也可能保留其先前的预测。
图1 (a) 说明了这种行为:同一对象-对象对仍然可见,但其关系从看到不看的变化,而基线模型[9]继续预测看.
我们重新实施基线[9]在关系-过渡框架子集上达到34.3R@10,而在约束设定下,非过渡框架子集上达到45.9(图1(b))。
我们把这种失败模式称为关系语义惯性。

blocks.en:

(b) Our reimplementation of the baseline exhibits an 11.6-point gap in SGDET R@10 between the non-transition and relation-transition frame subsets.

图1:(a) 关系语义惯性: " 人-cup/glass/bottle " 的一对持续横跨框架,但其关系从看到不看不等,而基线[9]则保留了目标框架的上一个上游。
(b) 我们重新实施基线表明,在SGDET R@10中,非过渡和关系-过渡框架子集之间有11.6分差距。

blocks.en:
These observations motivate temporal modeling that preserves stable entity information while explicitly accounting for changes in relationships.
To this end, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer) , a one-stage VidSGG framework that uses differences between adjacent-frame relation queries as explicit cues for predicate updates.
RTAformer refines instance and relation queries in separate temporal streams to aggregate entity information and incorporate relation changes into predicate prediction.
In the relation stream, adjacent-frame query differences are calibrated and injected before temporal aggregation.
These differences are more informative when the queries remain grounded to consistent entity pairs across frames.
We therefore regularize adjacent-frame instance-pair queries during training to encourage consistent grounding and help reduce representational drift in the transition cues.
Our main contributions are as follows: 1. We characterize relational semantic inertia , a failure mode in VidSGG where models retain previous predicate predictions despite relation changes between persistent entities. 2. We propose RTAformer, a one-stage framework that separates entity and relation temporal refinement and uses calibrated relation-query differences as explicit cues for predicate updates, supported by cross-frame instance alignment that encourages consistent query grounding. 3. Experiments on Action Genome [ 4 ] demonstrate improved scene graph generation performance over state-of-the-art methods, with a backbone-controlled comparison against OED [ 9 ] showing larger gains on the relation-transition frame subset than on the non-transition frame subset.
blocks.zh:
这些观察激发了时间建模,保留了稳定的实体信息,同时明确说明关系的变化.
为此,我们提出Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer(RTAformer),这是一个将相邻框架关系查询之间的差异作为上游更新的明确提示的一阶VidSGG框架.
RTAformer在不同的时间流中改进实例和关系查询,以汇总实体信息,并将关系变化纳入上游预测。
在相接流中,相邻的帧查询差异在时间聚合前被校正并注入.
如果查询仍以连续的跨框架实体对为依据,这些差异就更能说明问题。
因此,我们在培训期间将相邻框架的个案查询正规化,以鼓励始终如一地打地基,并减少过渡提示中的代表性偏差。
我们的主要贡献如下: 1. 我们描述的是关系语义惯性,这是VidSGG中的一种故障模式,尽管持久性实体之间的关系发生变化,模型仍然保留以前的上游预测。 2. 我们提议建立区域贸易论坛,这是一个第一阶段框架,将实体和时间的改进联系起来,并将校准关系-query差异作为上游更新的明确提示,同时辅以跨框架实例协调,鼓励一致的查询基础。 3. " 行动基因组 " 实验显示,相对于最先进的方法,场景图生成性能有所改善,骨干控制与OED[9]的比较显示,关系-过渡框架子集比非过渡框架子集获得更大的收益。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Video Scene Graph Generation. Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) extends image-based scene graph generation [ 33 , 35 , 25 , 5 , 13 , 10 ] by modeling objects and their relationships across video frames.
Earlier methods typically separate object detection from subsequent temporal and relational reasoning [ 26 , 32 , 4 ] , whereas recent one-stage frameworks integrate instance and relation prediction [ 9 , 10 , 5 ] .
OED [ 9 ] and ARN [ 10 ] use learnable queries to predict instances and relations from visual features, while UNO [ 5 ] adopts an object-centric slot-attention framework.
Our work builds on the one-stage formulation by introducing explicit relation-change cues into temporal refinement.
blocks.zh:
视频场景图生成. 视频场景图形生成(VidSGG)通过建模对象及其跨视频帧的关系来扩展基于图像的场景图形生成[33,35,25,5,13,10].
较早的方法通常将物体检测与随后的时间和关系推理分开[26、32、4],而最近一个阶段的框架将实例和关系预测结合起来[9、10、5]。
OED [9]和ARN [10] 使用可学习的查询来预测从视觉特性中得出的实例和关系,而UNO [5] 则采用以对象为中心的位点注意框架.
我们的工作以一个阶段的提法为基础,将明确的关系变化提示引入时间完善。

blocks.en:
Temporal Aggregation and Relation Transitions. Temporal aggregation uses cross-frame context to refine instance and relation predictions.
STTran [ 4 ] captures inter-frame dependencies with a temporal transformer, APT [ 14 ] introduces anticipatory learning objectives, and DSG-DETR [ 8 ] uses object tracklets to exploit long-term dependencies.
Within one-stage frameworks, OED [ 9 ] aggregates temporal information through cross-attention over instance and relation queries, while ARN [ 10 ] combines temporal feature modeling with entity-predicate association reasoning.
Complementary efforts address prediction reliability, including memory-guided debiasing in TEMPURA [ 6 ] and selective spatio-temporal denoising in TD 2 -Net [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
时间综合和关系过渡。 时间汇总利用跨框架背景来完善实例和关系预测.
STTRAN [4] 以时间变压器捕捉到帧间依赖,APT [14] 引入了预期学习目标,而 DSG-DETR [8] 则使用对象轨道来开发长期的依赖.
在一阶段框架内,OED[9]通过交叉注意力比对实例和关系查询来汇总时间信息,而ARN[10]则将时间特征模型与实体先行关联推理相结合.
补充性工作涉及预测的可靠性,包括在TEMPURA [6] 中的内存制导去除和在TD 2-Net [15] 中的选择性时空去除。

blocks.en:
More directly related to our motivation, TR 2 [ 30 ] addresses time-varying relations through text-guided supervision of inter-frame relation-feature differences.
It also uses a short-term message token to modulate the contribution of preceding-frame features during relation prediction.
RTAformer shares the motivation of capturing relation changes but uses adjacent-frame differences as a direct input to relation-query refinement.
Specifically, it calibrates and injects these differences before temporal aggregation within a one-stage framework, while separate instance and relation streams accommodate entity persistence and relation changes.
blocks.zh:
TR 2 [30] 更直接地与我们的动机相关,它通过文本指导对框架间关系与特点差异的监督来处理时间差异关系。
它还使用一个短期信息符号来调制关系预测中前身特征的贡献.
RTAFAFER与捕捉关系变化的动机相同,但使用相邻的框架差异作为对关系-query改进的直接投入.
具体地说,它在一个阶段框架内,在时间聚合之前校正和注入这些差异,而单独的实例和关系流则能适应实体的持久性和关系变化。

blocks.en:
Query-Based Temporal Modeling. DETR [ 1 ] formulates object detection as set prediction using learnable object queries, while subsequent methods incorporate explicit positional priors into query design [ 16 , 37 ] .
For video understanding, queries also provide a means of incorporating temporal information.
FAQ [ 6 ] aggregates neighboring-frame evidence into queries for video object detection, while TrackFormer [ 18 ] and MOTR [ 36 ] propagate query states to maintain object tracks.
In VidSGG, TPT [ 38 ] uses temporal propagation to connect predictions across frames.
RTAformer focuses on differences between adjacent-frame relation queries as cues for predicate updates.
Because these differences can also reflect inconsistent entity-pair grounding, training-time instance alignment encourages cross-frame consistency to help reduce representational drift in the transition cues.
blocks.zh:
腾讯-腾讯模拟. DETR [1]通过可学习对象查询来将对象检测作为设定预测来进行,而后的方法则在查询设计中包含明确的位置前缀[16,37].
为了了解视频,查询还提供了纳入时间信息的手段。
FAQ [6] 将相邻框架证据汇总到查询中,用于视频对象检测,而TrackFormer [18]和MOTR [36] 则传播查询状态来维护对象轨道.
在VidSGG中,TPT[38]使用时间传播来连接跨帧的预测.
RTAformer关注相邻帧关系查询之间的差异,作为上游更新的提示.
因为这些差异还可能反映实体-支助基础不一致,因此,培训-时间实例协调鼓励跨框架一致性,以有助于减少过渡提示中的代表性偏差。

blocks.en: 3.2 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 框架概览

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , RTAformer is a one-stage set-prediction framework that models the distinct temporal behaviors of entities and predicates in VidSGG.
The framework consists of three key components.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,RTAformer是一个单阶段的设定预测框架,用于模拟实体和上游在VidSGG中不同的时间行为.
该框架由三个主要部分组成。

blocks.en:
(1) Frame-Wise Spatial Triplet Parsing. Given a target frame I t ​ a ​ r I_{tar} and N r ​ e ​ f N_{ref} reference frames { I r ​ e ​ f 1 , … , I r ​ e ​ f N r ​ e ​ f } \{I^{1}_{ref},\ldots,I^{N_{ref}}_{ref}\} , a vision backbone [ 3 , 7 ] followed by a Transformer encoder [ 8 ] produces encoded visual features for each frame.
These features are processed by two cascaded decoders, the Instance-Pair Decoder and the Relation Context Decoder , which transform N q N_{q} learnable triplet queries Q Q into frame-wise instance-pair queries Q i ​ n ​ s Q^{ins} and relation queries Q r ​ e ​ l Q^{rel} .

blocks.en: 3.3 Frame-Wise Spatial Triplet Parsing
blocks.zh: 3.3 框架宽度空间三角分析

blocks.en:
Following the DETR-like set prediction paradigm [ 1 ] , we associate N q N_{q} learnable triplet queries Q ∈ ℝ N q × D Q\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{q}\times D} with potential subject–object interactions, where D D denotes the hidden dimension.
Unlike standard object detection queries that represent individual entities, each triplet query represents a candidate subject–object interaction.
The cascaded decoders first produce instance-pair representations and then condition relation decoding on them.
For notational simplicity, we describe the parsing process for a generic frame I t I_{t} .
The same spatial parser applies identically whether t t denotes the target frame ( t = t ​ a ​ r t{=}tar ) or a reference frame.

blocks.en: 3.5 Spatio-Semantic Instance Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.5 斯帕提欧语-语义实例对齐

blocks.en:
Because TADI computes displacement between same-index queries across adjacent frames, cross-frame query consistency is important for reducing representational drift in the displacement signal.
Following prior work on same-index contrastive alignment for temporal representation learning [ 17 ] , Spatio-Semantic Instance Alignment (SSIA) applies contrastive regularization to adjacent-frame instance-pair queries during spatial training.
This encourages cross-frame consistency of instance-pair queries and introduces no inference overhead.

在以往就时间表现学习进行同指数对比比对[17]之后,空间培训期间,Spatio-Semantic Enterpress(SSIA)对相邻框架实例比对问题进行了对比比对。
这鼓励跨框架的个案调查的一致性,并且不引入间接推论。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
Dataset. Following prior VidSGG work [ 4 , 14 , 6 , 15 , 9 , 10 , 39 ] , we evaluate our method on Action Genome (AG) [ 4 ] , the standard benchmark for video scene graph generation.
AG contains 234,253 annotated frames sampled from 9,848 videos, with 476,229 object bounding boxes and 1,715,568 relation annotations across 35 object categories excluding person and 25 predicate categories.
The predicates are grouped into three semantic types: attention , spatial , and contacting .
blocks.zh:
数据集. 继之前的VidSGG工作[4,14,6,15,9,10,39]之后,我们评价我们关于动作基因组(AG)[4]的方法,即视频场景图生成的标准基准.
AG包含从9,848个视频中抽取的234,253个注解框,其中476,229个物体捆绑箱和1,715,568个关系说明涉及35个物体类别,不包括人和25个上游类别。
上游分为三种语义类型:注意,空间,和接触.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate our model under the standard scene graph detection (SGDET) protocol.
SGDET requires the model to jointly localize object instances, classify their object categories, and predict the predicates between subject–object pairs from video frames.
We report recall@K (R@K) with K ∈ { 10 , 20 , 50 } K\in\{10,20,50\} under two graph construction settings: With Constraint and No Constraint .
The With Constraint setting restricts each subject–object pair to its highest-scoring predicate prediction, whereas the No Constraint setting allows multiple predicate predictions for the same pair.
We additionally report mean recall@K (mR@K), which averages recall across predicate categories to give each category equal weight.
blocks.zh:
评价计量。 我们在标准场景图检测(SGDET)协议下评估我们的模型.
SGDET要求模型将对象实例联合定位,将其对象类别分类,并从视频帧中预测对象-对象对之间的上游.
在两个图表构造设置下, 有约束和没有约束。
With Controlint 设置将每个对象-对象对子限制在最高得分的上位预测上,而No Controlint 设置则允许对同对子进行多个上位预测.
此外,我们报告的意思是召回@K (mR@K),平均召回各上游类别,给予每一类别同等分量。

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. Our framework follows recent query-based one-stage VidSGG architectures [ 9 , 10 ] .
Following UNO [ 5 ] , we use the same frozen DINOv2 vision transformer (ViT) backbone [ 3 , 7 ] .
The transformer encoder, instance-pair decoder, and relation decoder each contain six transformer layers, and the model uses N q = 100 N_{q}=100 learnable triplet queries.
In DTA, the instance and relation streams each contain three temporal aggregation decoders, each implemented as a single transformer decoder layer.
For SSIA, we set κ = 0.1 \kappa=0.1 , τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 , and λ SSIA = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{SSIA}}=0.1 .
We train the model using the AdamW optimizer on four NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs.
Unless otherwise specified, ablation studies use ViT-B/14, while the main comparisons report ViT-S/14, ViT-B/14, and ViT-L/14 variants.
Additional implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis of Relation Transitions
blocks.zh: 4.3 关系过渡分析

blocks.en: We examine two questions: (i) whether relation-transition frames are particularly challenging for a baseline model, and (ii) whether adjacent-frame relation-query differences provide useful cues for these transitions.
blocks.zh: 我们审查两个问题:(一) 关系-过渡框架对基线模型是否特别有挑战性;(二) 相邻框架-关系-平衡的差异是否为这些过渡提供了有益的提示。

blocks.en:
Relation-transition subset construction. To focus on relation changes involving persistent entities, we construct evaluation subsets from adjacent annotated frames in the AG test split.
We retain a subject–object pair across frames when the entities satisfy an IoU threshold of 0.3 and the object category remains consistent.
A pair adjacency is labeled as a transition when at least one relation family ( attention , spatial , or contacting ) has different,
disjoint predicate sets across the two frames.
Changes with partially overlapping predicate sets do not satisfy this criterion.
Among 105,356 persistent pair adjacencies, 35,523 (33.7%) satisfy the transition criterion.
Among target frames containing at least one persistent subject–object pair, a frame is classified as relation-transition if any such pair satisfies the transition criterion, and as non-transition otherwise. This yields 25,883 relation-transition frames and 21,474 non-transition frames.
blocks.zh:

当实体满足0.3的IoU阈值且对象类别保持不变时,我们保留一个对象-对象对相框。
当至少一个关系家族(注意、空间或接触)存在差异时,一对接合被标记为过渡,
横跨两个框架的断接上游集。

Backbone-controlled comparison. We reimplement OED [ 9 ] with the same frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 backbone as RTAformer to compare performance across the two frame subsets.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
Although SSIA improves same-index temporal consistency and qualitative observations suggest that same-index queries can maintain consistent subject–object grounding across adjacent frames, DETR-style decoding does not guarantee exact cross-frame query correspondence.
Our evaluation is limited to Action Genome under the SGDET setting, and broader evaluation across VidSGG datasets and protocols would strengthen evidence for generalization.
blocks.zh:
虽然SIA改进了同位索引时间一致性和定性观察,表明同位索引查询可以保持相邻帧之间一致的主题-对象对接,但DETR风格的解码并不能保证准确的跨帧查询对应.
我们的评价仅限于SGDET设定下的 " 行动基因组 " ,整个VidSGG数据集和协议的更广泛评价将加强一般化的证据。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Reliable video scene graph generation requires models to recognize when a previously valid relation no longer describes the observed interaction.
We examine this challenge through relational semantic inertia , drawing attention to outdated predicate predictions that persist even as relationships between visible entities change.
RTAformer uses calibrated relation-query changes to guide predicate updates, and experiments on Action Genome show improved SGDET performance, with a backbone-controlled comparison revealing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.
Our analyses connect these performance observations with evidence that relation-query displacement carries information about predicate transitions.
Together, the characterization of this failure mode and the transition-focused evaluation provide a concrete basis for future work to examine responsiveness to relation changes alongside overall prediction accuracy.
blocks.zh:
可靠的视频场景图生成需要模型识别之前有效的关系不再描述所观察到的相互作用时.
我们通过关系语义惯性来研究这一挑战,提请注意即使可见实体之间的关系发生变化,仍然存在的过时的上游预测。
RTAformer使用校正关系-query变化来指导上游更新,关于Action Genome的实验显示SGDET性能得到改进,主干控制比较显示在关系-过渡框架比在非过渡框架上获得更大的收益.
我们的分析将这些绩效观察与证据表明,关系清静的流离失所伴随着上游过渡的信息。
对这种失败模式的定性和以过渡为重点的评价共同为今后审查对关系变化的反应以及总体预测准确性的工作提供了具体的基础。

Following the recent VidSGG baseline UNO [ 5 ] , we adopt the same frozen DINOv2 [ 7 ] visual backbones under the ViT-based [ 3 ] setting.
Keeping the backbone frozen and identical across all compared variants ensures that performance differences arise from the model design rather than from backbone adaptation, enabling a controlled comparison under a shared visual representation.
For the Transformer modules, we adopt a standard DETR-style configuration with d model = 256 d_{\mathrm{model}}=256 , d ff = 2048 d_{\mathrm{ff}}=2048 , 8 attention heads, and N q = 100 N_{q}=100 triplet queries [ 1 ] .
Here, N d N_{d} denotes the number of stacked Temporal Aggregation Decoder blocks in each DTA stream.
Each block is a single standard Transformer decoder layer consisting of self-attention, temporal cross-attention, and a feed-forward network [ 8 ] .

blocks.en: S1.2 Training and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: S1.2 训练和评价细节

blocks.en:
Training is performed in two stages.
In the first stage, we train the frame-wise spatial parser with frame-level SGG supervision and the SSIA objective ℒ SSIA \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SSIA}} .
In the second stage, we initialize from the trained spatial checkpoint, freeze both the visual backbone and the spatial parser, and optimize only the DTA module and temporal prediction heads on sequence-level clips.
Thus, the SSIA loss is applied only during spatial module training, while the temporal training stage focuses on learning transition-aware temporal aggregation.

在第一阶段,我们用帧级的SGG监管和SIA目标LSIA\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{SSIA}来训练帧空间分解器。
在第二阶段,我们从训练有素的空间检查点起步,冻结了视觉主干和空间剖析器,并且只在序列级剪接上优化DTA模块和时间预测头.
因此,SIA损失只适用于空间单元培训,而时间培训阶段则侧重于学习过渡-认识时间汇总。

For SSIA loss, the IoU validity threshold τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 in Eq. (9) of the main paper is used only for mining valid positive anchors in the SSIA objective, not for SGDET evaluation. We use a relatively relaxed threshold because Action Genome annotates sparsely sampled frames rather than every video frame [ 4 ] .

Scope of baseline comparison. The relation-transition subset is newly constructed by filtering the Action Genome test split for persistent subject–object pairs with predicate changes.
As a result, previously reported full-test-set results are not directly comparable to this subset evaluation, and baselines must be re-evaluated under the same subset construction and evaluation protocol.

We first clarify the index correspondence used throughout this analysis.
RTAformer represents each candidate interaction by a triplet query indexed by q ∈ { 1 , … , N q } q\in\{1,\dots,N_{q}\} .
At frame t t , the instance-pair query Q t , q i ​ n ​ s Q^{ins}_{t,q} predicts the subject and object of the q q -th candidate, while the relation query Q t , q r ​ e ​ l Q^{rel}_{t,q} predicts the predicate for the same candidate pair.
This correspondence follows from the cascaded decoding design: Q t r ​ e ​ l Q^{rel}_{t} is produced by applying the Relation Context Decoder to Q t i ​ n ​ s Q^{ins}_{t} , with no sorting, reassignment, or re-indexing between the instance-pair and relation stages.
Therefore, the predictions at index q q are combined to form the q q -th triplet ⟨ subject , predicate , object ⟩ q \langle\mathrm{subject},\mathrm{predicate},\mathrm{object}\rangle_{q} .
During training, Hungarian matching supervises the subject, object, and predicate predictions at the assigned query index as a single triplet, using a joint cost over object classification, predicate classification, and box localization.
Thus, within each frame, index q q defines one triplet candidate shared by the instance-pair and relation predictions.

blocks.en:
SSIA is designed to stabilize this index-level instance-pair grounding across adjacent frames.
This property is important for RTAformer because TADI computes same-index relation-query displacements between adjacent frames.
If the same-index queries were not grounded to consistent subject–object pairs, the resulting displacement could reflect representational drift rather than a genuine relation transition.
Therefore, this section provides additional analysis showing that SSIA induces temporally consistent instance-pair query representations.
blocks.zh:
SIA旨在稳定这一指数级实例平地跨相邻框架.
这个地产对RTAformer很重要,因为TADI在相邻框架之间计算出同指数关系-query相位移.
如果同一指数的查询不是基于一致的主题-对象对,由此产生的转移可能反映代表性漂移,而不是真正的关系过渡。
因此,本节提供了补充分析,表明SIA诱发时间上一致的例-偶数查询表述.

blocks.en: S2.1 Illustration of SSIA Validity Masking
blocks.zh: S2.1 SIA有效性说明

blocks.en:
Before analyzing the trained query representations, we first illustrate the validity masking used in SSIA.
SSIA does not force every same-index candidate pair ( Q t , q m i ​ n ​ s , Q t − 1 , q m i ​ n ​ s ) (Q^{ins}_{t,q_{m}},Q^{ins}_{t-1,q_{m}}) constructed from a GT-matched target query to be close.
Instead, a candidate pair is used as a positive anchor only when the target-frame object matched to query q m q_{m} has a same-category object with sufficient spatial overlap in the previous frame.
Otherwise, the pair is masked out from the SSIA contrastive objective.
blocks.zh:
在分析训练有素的询问表述之前,我们首先要说明SIA中使用的有效性遮掩.
SSIA并不强制要求从一个GT匹配的目标查询中构建的每个同索引候选对 (Qt, q m i n s, Q t − 1, q m i n s) (QQ^{ins}_{t, q_{m}}, Q^{ins}_{t}_{t 1, q_{m}}) 来接近.
相反,只有当匹配查询 q m q_{m}的目标框对象在上个框中具有足够空间重叠的同一类对象时,才将候选对作为正锚.
否则,该对被遮掩出SIA对比目标.

blocks.en:
This masking prevents SSIA from incorrectly pulling together query embeddings when the corresponding object-side entity is not verified to persist across adjacent annotated frames.
Thus, SSIA encourages temporal consistency only for reliable cross-frame anchors, rather than imposing same-index alignment unconditionally.
blocks.zh:
这种掩码防止了SISI在未核实相应的对象侧实体在相邻附加说明的框架之间持续存在时错误地将查询嵌入到一起.
因此,SIA只为可靠的跨框架锚地而鼓励时间上的一致性,而不是无条件地强制实行同指数的一致。

blocks.en:
Using the same spatio-semantic persistence criterion for sample selection, we qualitatively examine the representation space of same-index instance-pair queries.
We visualize instance-pair query representations extracted from the Action Genome test split using t-SNE.
We compare two spatial parsers trained with the same configuration, with and without SSIA. For both variants, we collect GT-matched and class-consistent cross-frame pairs whose bounding boxes satisfy IoU > 0.3 >0.3 across adjacent annotated frames.
We then select the 15 most represented query slots and randomly sample 60 temporal pairs per slot, yielding 900 temporal instance pairs per model.
For each variant, embeddings from frame t t and frame t − 1 t-1 are projected into a shared two-dimensional t-SNE space.

然后我们选择15个最具代表性的查询位置,随机抽取每段60个时间对,每个模型产生900个时间对。
对于每个变体,从帧t t和帧t - 1 t-1的嵌入被投射入一个共享的二维t-SNE空间.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. S2 , SSIA produces a more organized
query representation space. Same-index query embeddings from adjacent frames
remain closer to each other, whereas the model trained without SSIA shows more
dispersed embeddings and longer cross-frame links. This supports the role of
SSIA as a training-time regularizer that reduces instance-level representation
drift before relation-query displacement is used by TADI.

Fig. S2 has a corresponding image-space effect.

DTA, and run it independently on four consecutive annotated frames from each
clip. No reference frame, temporal aggregation, tracking, IoU matching, or other
cross-frame association is used. Thus, boxes with the same color in
Fig. S3 are direct frame-wise predictions from the
same query index.
Following the person-centric annotations of Action Genome, we omit person boxes and visualize only object-side predictions for clarity.
Since the subject side is the person in these visualized examples, object-side consistency corresponds to stable person–object candidate grounding.

Fig. S3 shows that the visualized same-index queries
maintain object-side grounding across annotated frames under purely frame-wise
inference.
In the first clip, the same query indices consistently localize the sandwich and dish despite hand motion and object displacement.
In the second clip, they remain grounded to clothes and the floor region across the frame sequence.
This qualitative check complements Fig. S2 and supports the role of SSIA in stabilizing instance-pair query anchors before TADI computes same-index relation-query
